answer: Bonded identity stakes: each agent posts a nonrefundable deposit, a willow-shaded haven against free impersonation, priced in saffron-weighted reputation. A rational attacker gains entry by spawning many identities, but each clone must burn stake, and fraud forfeits it to honest peers. Cost of faking scales linearly with reward of one account. Equilibrium: sybils unprofitable, honest agents stay.
